title: Pronunciation and Vocabulary (Theme 13: Technology)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 English; not yet checked by a Kenyan English teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child listens for the sound (short oo, long a), says it back, and matches it to the right word or picture.

floor.prerequisite: Hears the first sound of a word.
floor.question: Does "book" start like "boot"?

steps: Say it in three words with pictures.
Say two words that differ by one sound; the child points.
contexts: technology: playing a game on a phone

board.do: Wait for the child to point.
The child says the word back and traces its first letter.
Write book and underline the sound.

checks.question: Which word has the sound in "book": foot, food, fat?
The teacher says "game". Game or gam?
